verified.label: Verified
verified.summary: A consistent, consented owner account with no red flags.

reasons: Synthetic example: the owner describes daily operations, crew size and equipment consistently.
Consent was recorded before any identity or intent questions.

answers.credible_owner: Yes; the account of hiring, scheduling and pricing is specific and consistent.
answers.business_operating: Yes; recent jobs and seasonal workload are described.
answers.genuine_intent: Yes; a succession timeline and reasons for selling are stated.

limitations: Scripted replay; no real person or business was reviewed.

concerns.label: Concerns
concerns.summary: Plausible owner account with gaps that need follow-up before relying on it.

reasons: Synthetic example: operations are described plausibly, but ownership share is vague.
red_flags: Speaker is unsure whether they hold majority ownership.

answers.credible_owner: Unclear; may be a minority partner or manager.
answers.genuine_intent: Partly; selling depends on a partner who was not on the call.

limitations: Scripted replay; no real person or business was reviewed.

fail.label: Fail
fail.summary: Material contradictions indicate the speaker is not a credible operating owner.

reasons: Synthetic example: the stated crew size and annual job count contradict each other twice.
red_flags: Cannot name the equipment the business owns.
Asks for an upfront fee before sharing any business details.

answers.genuine_intent: No; the call focuses on fees rather than a sale.

limitations: Scripted replay; no real person or business was reviewed.
